result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best project management tool if you're building a tech or SaaS company.** If you're running a broader business with marketing, sales, operations and product teams, I'd lean towards **ClickUp or Notion**\.

The best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size and how much structure you need.

## My top 5 project management tools for startups

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. ClickUp**

(Best overall)

- Tasks, goals, docs and dashboards in one place.
- Good for product, marketing, operations and sales.
- Highly customisable.
- Downside: Can become complicated if overconfigured.

Website: [ClickUp](https://clickup.com)

---

![Filters – Linear Docs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eyMo9-629EFMH4kSRnjYVxekk9g9EbU0LnWeWPRcoBVwhrD3VGA2dcUzDsPgQI5kxvNkz3CWhwq1BeBLZEsopIAAdnFH7npXepYyzijDplCz4agNv3S_BtwgaEv36pfzl04o5Ah67np0cuCEHjtgIl0Ku8IzhHXKsYDvi9p0DbLGXwbiuzJtSE78kCcjr1EK?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Great developer workflows and GitHub integration.
- Fast, clean and focused interface.
- Downside: Less suitable for general business operations.

Website: [Linear](https://linear.app)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Combines documentation, knowledge base and task management.
- Great for company strategy, SOPs and meeting notes.
- Flexible and easy to start.
- Downside: Less structured project execution.

Website: [Notion](https://notion.so)

---

![Introducing Status for remote work • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JoierB-tO_00cduG2D81oKuCvdoyZCElp3bd35lcWALcBpW38axGIp0CC5GaQbqWOOkxY6bkkYIgINigcMs7b9WeuaVIp_po7Lw148-t-fKTF_zSNsVOvmWGGRaLv9NtvMW858uJe_Q2tTfzckYfVF8jui4Tyz-v30ONFO8slcrt9_8tb3TIFzeV-apOQxtA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent cross-team collaboration.
- Strong project timelines and accountability.
- Good for marketing, operations and business teams.
- Downside: Can become expensive as the team grows.

Website: [Asana](https://asana.com)

---

![Monday Vibe | Build Custom Apps with Vibe Coding & AI Prompts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dZbPOy2ExCYPWkRUN-y8aNBArPHAy5RJyF2Fv3kOH8r0onm7GzQMtNgFLnlF_orijMr1L_hlS3rZ5CmII7wcg1sC5QIg6R8JlCgddpaNU2x9UGq4FrFp6DOJXu4JvN0TyREqPyEMky1tg6L3RhInST4tHJiMa0BGxgH61Ibvrnb8NABR1soD10zbitKXa9pg?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Very visual project dashboards.
- Excellent automation and workflow customisation.
- Good for growing teams with multiple departments.
- Downside: Can be more than a small startup needs.

Website: [Monday.com](https://monday.com)

These choices reflect the different startup workflows highlighted in current 2026 comparisons. ## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–3 founders, pre-seed | Notion |
| 3–10 people, general startup | ClickUp |
| SaaS / software startup | Linear + Notion |
| 10–30 people, growing teams | ClickUp or Asana |
| Multiple departments and complex workflows | Monday.com |
